commands.name: If
commands.note: Logic_Commands.json types <Then>/<Else> as <Object>, but the kernel evaluates them as expressions, so a bare value literal is legal (If(cond, 1, 2)). Re-declaring them as <Expression> keeps those calls valid while object wildcards stay strict.
